The '''Angrallia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Fath sector/Legends|Fath sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]].<ref name="New Territories" /> It was home to a creature known as [[Angrallian Toobir]].<ref name="SW:XWA" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Angrallia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square K-6.<ref name="EAOC" />
